facebook.text:
The format tax is real.

One idea turns into three files: square, story, and wide. Then the small edits start. Text size, spacing, crops, logo placement. Every post quietly costs another ten to twenty minutes.

Poaster makes all three from one link or prompt, with your saved brand kit applied. The resizing drops out of the workflow and the minutes go back to planning content.

Swipe for the five-slide version. poaster.co is free to try, 3 downloads before you create an account.
